text: 25-year-old female. The patient has a history of polycystic ovarian syndrome, depression, and chronic bilateral ear infections. She underwent right ear tympanoplasty 12 weeks ago. speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any jaw clicking, popping, or pain when opening your mouth wide, and is the pain localized to the area around the ear canal or deeper near the jaw joint? I am concerned about possible temporomandibular joint dysfunction exacerbated by stress.

speaker: Doctor
